name: Ophrasian War
definition: A cataclysmic conflict that lasted for forty years, reshaping the borders of Maltona and leaving the Boundless Vale scarred by a new, dark form of magic.

name: Void Crystal
definition: A rare mineral found only in the deepest reaches of Blackreach; it hums with the frequency of the Ethereal Plane.

name: Behemoth
definition: A colossal, mutated fungal beast native to the deepest caverns of Maltona. Highly dangerous.

name: Vale House
definition: A mysterious demi-plane consisting of a pristine yet apparently abandoned mansion, once inhabited by a mysterious spellcaster named Alensia.

name: Alensia
definition: Wizard creator and owner of the Vale House, apparently involved with Freyot in a way.

name: Freyot
definition: Mysterious figure brought up by the homonculi that still inhabit the Vale House.

name: Ekelph
definition: An alternative script used by the Doleris. Mostly thought to have been used to encrypt messages.

name: Nihilium
definition: A crystallization of Void energy that started to plague the Material Plane as a result of a botched spell at the end of the Ophrasian War.
